round: Haiku makers, kit 62a99a6 (before the loop-start and envelope warnings)
verdict: adequate as replacements, both legs; not passes on likeness
said: the sprites, I like both variants of generation. the words vs pictures are pretty close, so this aspect is working well. Genuinely, I don't think they need improvement. They aren't exact but they aren't supposed to be. It looks really good.

notes.fire (both legs): your fire is superior to theirs.
notes.flare1: words was superior to pictures on flare in the general shape, but the color gradient doesn't match. It's VERY close, I would say purple vs the original's pink-ish or whiter purple
notes.on the rubric: I think it's right to reject if it can be made better to fit the original. But I just meant as replacements they are adequate. If you were grading them on likeness to the original I agree there are differences
